description:
Amazon PPC Executive

Location: Milton Keynes

Our client is looking for an Amazon PPC Executive to join their team on a full time permeant basis. As an Amazon PPC Executive, you will be at the forefront of managing and optimising Amazon advertising campaigns to drive traffic and sales. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, analytical skills, and strong communication abilities. You will play a pivotal role in the company's marketing efforts, ensuring that advertising campaigns are performing optimally and contributing to the business's success.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
- Conduct keyword research to identify relevant and high-traffic keywords for ad campaigns.
- Create and launch PPC campaigns on Amazon using tools such as Amazon Advertising Console.
- Write compelling ad copy that accurately represents the product and entices customers to click.
- Monitor and adjust bids to ensure optimal campaign performance while staying within budget.
- Analyse campaign data and make adjustments to improve performance, such as targeting and ad placement.
- Produce reports that clearly communicate campaign results and insights to the team.
- Conduct A/B tests to determine the most effective ad copy, keywords, and targeting strategies.
- Manage advertising budgets to align spending with business goals and objectives.
- Analyse competitor advertising campaigns to identify opportunities and threats.
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and changes to Amazon's advertising platform.

Skills and Experience:
- Proven expertise in PPC advertising principles and best practices.
- Strong analytical skills to analyse campaign performance data and produce insightful reports.
- Knowledge of keyword research tools and techniques.
- Ability to write compelling and effective ad copy.
- Experience managing bid strategies and budgets for optimal campaign performance.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across various teams.
- Attention to detail to ensure campaigns are set up and managed correctly.
- A willingness to stay current with industry trends and changes.

Company Benefits:
- Casual dress
- On-site parking
- Regular social events including summer and end-of-year parties
- Spontaneous employee well-being treats
- Vouchers at Christmas to shop with the company
- Private medical insurance
- Gym membership discounts

description:
E-commerce Merchandise Lead

Location: Milton Keynes (Office Based)

Are you a creative visionary with a knack for eCommerce? Our client is seeking an experienced E-commerce Merchandise Lead to join their dynamic team. This is an exciting role for someone passionate about driving the visual and creative presence of a brand across major eCommerce platforms like Amazon, TikTok Shop, and SHEIN. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a strong commercial insight, this role could be your next career move.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
- Own all creative output across Amazon, TikTok Shop, and SHEIN, ensuring content meets platform requirements and eCommerce best practices.
- Oversee the creation of product imagery, A+ Content, videos, infographics, lifestyle imagery, and campaign assets, optimising for customer engagement and conversion.
- Lead the use of AI-powered creative tools to create, enhance, and optimise product images, videos, and marketplace assets in line with Amazon creative guidelines and marketplace best practices.
- Conduct competitive merchandise analysis to identify market trends, creative best practices, and commercial opportunities.
- Advise the business, eCommerce, and marketing teams on merchandise strategy, product presentation, content priorities, and marketplace optimisation opportunities.
- Lead and manage a creative team including Senior Graphic Designers, Graphic Designer Trainees, a Photographer, a Stylist, and offshore designers.
- Plan and allocate team resources, prioritise workloads, and manage creative capacity to deliver projects on time and to a high standard.

Skills and Experience:
- Proven experience in eCommerce creative, with strong Amazon marketplace expertise.
- Strong understanding of Amazon creative requirements, A+ Content, image compliance standards, and marketplace optimisation techniques.
- Hands-on experience using AI tools to generate and optimise images, videos, and eCommerce content.
- Experience managing and mentoring creative teams.
- Strong commercial awareness, analytical skills, and ability to advise on merchandise strategy.
- Excellent organisational and planning skills; thrives in a fast-paced environment.

title: HR Administrator
description:
We are seeking a highly organised HR Administrator to join our client based in Milton Keynes. This is a key administrative role supporting the HR team with day-to-day people processes and ensuring employee records are maintained accurately and confidentially.

This is an immediate start temporary position, ideal for an experienced administrator with previous HR administration experience who is happy to work in a school environment.

You will be required to pass an enhanced DBS check if offered the role.

Key responsibilities for this role include:
- Maintaining accurate employee records and updating HR systems
- Supporting the onboarding process, including preparing contracts and new starter documentation
- Assisting with recruitment administration, arranging interviews and communicating with candidates
- Managing HR inboxes and responding to employee queries in a timely and professional manner
- Processing employee documentation, including letters, amendments, and leaver paperwork
- Supporting absence management administration and maintaining attendance records
- Ensuring all personnel files are compliant and up to date
- Providing general administrative support to the HR team while handling confidential information with discretion

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience in an HR Administration or administrative support role
- Excellent organisational and communication skills
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Experience using Teams
- The ability to manage confidential information professionally
- Availability to start immediately

This is an excellent opportunity to join a busy team and provide valuable support during a short-term assignment.

Please note that no terminology in this advert is intended to discriminate on the grounds of a person's gender, marital status, race, religion, colour, age, disability or sexual orientation. Every candidate will be assessed only in accordance with their merits, qualifications and ability to perform the duties of the job.

title: Marketing Automation Manager
description:
Marketing Automation & HubSpot Specialist

Milton Keynes Hybrid
£45,000 - £50,000

We're working with a growing B2 B business in Milton Keynes looking for a Marketing Automation & HubSpot Specialist to take ownership of HubSpot, automation and lead nurture.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys improving how marketing technology works, building smarter customer journeys and helping turn marketing engagement into genuine sales opportunities.

What you'll be doing
- Taking ownership of HubSpot Marketing Hub
- Building and optimising automated workflows and nurture journeys
- Managing lead scoring, segmentation and lifecycle stages
- Creating targeted email campaigns
- Improving MQL to SQL conversion alongside Sales
- Building dashboards to track campaign performance, pipeline and attribution
- Managing landing pages, forms and lead capture processes
- Maintaining CRM data quality
- Exploring how AI and automation can improve marketing performance

What we're looking for
- Hands-on HubSpot experience
- Experience with marketing automation, email and nurture campaigns
- Understanding of B2 B lead generation and sales funnels
- Confident with reporting, data and campaign analysis
- Experience with lead scoring, segmentation and CRM management
- Comfortable working closely with both Marketing and Sales

Experience within B2 B technology, SaaS or professional services would be beneficial but isn't essential.

This is a great opportunity to take real ownership of HubSpot and help shape how a growing business uses marketing automation to generate and convert more opportunities.
